verses.en: O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
verses.pt: Ó Senhor, Deus da minha salvação, dia e noite clamo diante de ti.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
verses.en_bbe: <A Song. A Psalm. Of the sons of Korah. To the chief music-maker; put to Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil. Of Heman the Ezrahite.> O Lord, God of my salvation, I have been crying to you for help by day and by night:

verses.en: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
verses.pt: Chegue à tua presença a minha oração, inclina os teus ouvidos ao meu clamor;
verses.en_web: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
verses.en_bbe: Let my prayer come before you; give ear to my cry:

verses.en: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
verses.pt: porque a minha alma está cheia de angústias, e a minha vida se aproxima do Seol.
verses.en_web: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
verses.en_bbe: For my soul is full of evils, and my life has come near to the underworld.

verses.en: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
verses.pt: Já estou contado com os que descem à cova; estou como homem sem forças,
verses.en_web: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,
verses.en_bbe: I am numbered among those who go down into the earth; I have become like a man for whom there is no help:

verses.en: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
verses.pt: atirado entre os finados; como os mortos que jazem na sepultura, dos quais já não te lembras, e que são desamparados da tua mão.
verses.en_web: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.
verses.en_bbe: My soul is among the dead, like those in the underworld, to whom you give no more thought; for they are cut off from your care.

verses.en: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
verses.pt: Puseste-me na cova mais profunda, em lugares escuros, nas profundezas.
verses.en_web: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
verses.en_bbe: You have put me in the lowest deep, even in dark places.

verses.en: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
verses.pt: Sobre mim pesa a tua cólera; tu me esmagaste com todas as tuas ondas.
verses.en_web: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: The weight of your wrath is crushing me, all your waves have overcome me. (Selah.)

verses.en: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
verses.pt: Apartaste de mim os meus conhecidos, fizeste-me abominável para eles; estou encerrado e não posso sair.
verses.en_web: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
verses.en_bbe: You have sent my friends far away from me; you have made me a disgusting thing in their eyes: I am shut up, and not able to come out.

verses.en: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
verses.pt: Os meus olhos desfalecem por causa da aflição. Clamo a ti todo dia, Senhor, estendendo-te as minhas mãos.
verses.en_web: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.
verses.en_bbe: My eyes are wasting away because of my trouble: Lord, my cry has gone up to you every day, my hands are stretched out to you.

verses.en: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
verses.pt: Mostrarás tu maravilhas aos mortos? ou levantam-se os mortos para te louvar?
verses.en_web: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Will you do works of wonder for the dead? will the shades come back to give you praise? (Selah.)

verses.en: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
verses.pt: Será anunciada a tua benignidade na sepultura, ou a tua fidelidade no Abadom?
verses.en_web: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?
verses.en_bbe: Will the story of your mercy be given in the house of the dead? will news of your faith come to the place of destruction?

verses.en: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.pt: Serão conhecidas nas trevas as tuas maravilhas, e a tua justiça na terra do esquecimento?
verses.en_web: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.en_bbe: May there be knowledge of your wonders in the dark? or of your righteousness where memory is dead?

verses.en: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
verses.pt: Eu, porém, Senhor, clamo a ti; de madrugada a minha oração chega à tua presença.
verses.en_web: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.
verses.en_bbe: But to you did I send up my cry, O Lord; in the morning my prayer came before you.

verses.en: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?
verses.pt: Senhor, por que me rejeitas? por que escondes de mim a tua face?
verses.en_web: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
verses.en_bbe: Lord, why have you sent away my soul? why is your face covered from me?

verses.en: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
verses.pt: Estou aflito, e prestes a morrer desde a minha mocidade; sofro os teus terrores, estou desamparado.
verses.en_web: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
verses.en_bbe: I have been troubled and in fear of death from the time when I was young; your wrath is hard on me, and I have no strength.

verses.en: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
verses.pt: Sobre mim tem passado a tua ardente indignação; os teus terrores deram cabo de mim.
verses.en_web: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
verses.en_bbe: The heat of your wrath has gone over me; I am broken by your cruel punishments.

verses.en: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
verses.pt: Como águas me rodeiam todo o dia; cercam-me todos juntos.
verses.en_web: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.
verses.en_bbe: They are round me all the day like water; they have made a circle about me.

verses.en: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
verses.pt: Aparte de mim amigos e companheiros; os meus conhecidos se acham nas trevas.
verses.en_web: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
verses.en_bbe: You have sent my friends and lovers far from me; I am gone from the memory of those who are dear to me.
